label: s2_sub_043_student_f_01
text: Over and under, over and under...\nGalarica Twigs go all around...\c\nAnd a nice accessory is what we’ve wound!

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_02
text: I can weave you a Galarica Cuff or a Galarica\nWreath if you bring me some Galarica Twigs!

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_03
text: Oh, no Galarica accessories for you, huh? Well,\ncome back whenever you feel like it!

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_04
text: I’ll need eight Galarica Twigs to make you a\nGalarica Cuff. Is that OK?

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_05
text: I’ll need fifteen Galarica Twigs to make you a\nGalarica Wreath. Is that OK?

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_06
text: You don’t have enough Galarica Twigs!\c\nTry wandering around the Coastal Biome—\nI’m sure you’ll pick up a few!

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_07
text: You got it! I’ll get it woven in no time!

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_08
text: Over, under, around we go...\nOver, under, watch it grow...

label: s2_sub_043_student_f_10
text: Try giving that to a Galarian Slowpoke.\nYou’ll see why!
